SELECT "security_name_id", "abor_security_id", "sedol", "esm_incorp_country_name", "esm_incorp_country_code", "sst_custody_account_code", "model_portfolio_id", "balance_nominal_number", "abor_security_type_id", "isin", "business_date", "portfolio_group_name", "portfolio_group_id", "portfolio_name", "portfolio_id", "abor_instrument_type_id", "abor_security_type_name", "quotation_currency_name", "balance_cost_value_quotation_currency", "clean_price_quotation_currency", "clean_value_quotation_currency", "clean_price_portfolio_currency", "clean_value_portfolio_currency", "esm_country_code", "esm_country_name", "country_ref_code", "country_ref_name", "issuer_country_code", "investment_strategy_name", "investment_department_name", "investmentstructurelevel3", "investmentstructurelevel4", "model_portfolio_name", "balance_book_value_quotation_currency", "balance_book_value_portfolio_currency", "quotation_currency_code", "dirty_price", "dirty_value_total_quotation_currency", "dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency", "cppib_country_of_exposure_name", "abor_security_number", "cppib_sec_id", "underlying_security_id", "underlying_isin", "underlying_sedol", "cppib_currency_of_exposure_name", "esm_next_coupon_date", "first_calculation_period_start_date", "balance_transaction_costs_quotation_currency", "balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency", "balance_transaction_costs_portfolio_currency", "balance_expected_restitution_quotation_currency", "balance_expected_restitution_portfolio_currency", "accrued_interest_end_of_period_quotation_currency", "long_settlement_correction_value_quotation_currency", "next_dividend_quotation_currency", "next_coupon_quotation_currency", "balance_nominal_number_unsettled"
FROM (select 
    es.security_name_id,
	shm.abor_security_id,
	es.sedol,
	rcc.country_name,
	asi.incorp_country_code, 
	smp.sst_custody_account_code,
	shm.model_portfolio_id,
	shm.balance_nominal_number,
	ss.abor_security_type_id,
	es.isin,
	cast(shm.business_date as date) as business_date,
	sp.portfolio_group_name,
	sp.portfolio_group_id,
	sp.portfolio_name,
	shm.portfolio_id,
	ss.abor_instrument_type_id,
	ss.abor_security_type_name,
	shm.quotation_currency_name,
	shm.balance_cost_value_quotation_currency,
	shm.clean_price clean_price_quotation_currency,
	shm.clean_value_quotation_currency,
	shm.clean_price * shm.fx_rate_quotation_currency_to_portfolio_currency clean_price_portfolio_currency,
	shm.clean_value_portfolio_currency,
	es.esm_country_code,
	rcc_esm.country_name as esm_country_name,
	es.esm_incorp_country_code,
	rcc_incorp_country.country_name as esm_incorp_country_name,
	rec.country_ref_code,
	rcc_trade_country.country_name as country_ref_name,
	smp.investment_strategy_name,
	smp.investment_department_name,
	spif.investmentstructurelevel3,
	spif.investmentstructurelevel4,
	smp.model_portfolio_name,
	shm.balance_book_value_quotation_currency,
	shm.balance_book_value_portfolio_currency,
	shm.quotation_currency_code,
	shm.dirty_price,
	shm.dirty_value_total_quotation_currency,
	shm.dirty_value_total_portfolio_currency,
	es.cppib_country_of_exposure_name,
	shm.abor_security_number,
	es.cppib_sec_id,
	ss_ul.abor_security_id as underlying_security_id,
	ss_ul.isin_id as underlying_isin,
	ss_ul.sedol_id as underlying_sedol,
	es.cppib_currency_of_exposure_name,
	es.esm_next_coupon_date,
	it.first_calculation_period_start_date,
	shm.balance_transaction_costs_quotation_currency,
	shm.balance_cost_value_portfolio_currency,
	shm.balance_transaction_costs_portfolio_currency,
	shm.balance_expected_restitution_quotation_currency,
	shm.balance_expected_restitution_portfolio_currency,
	shm.accrued_interest_end_of_period_quotation_currency,
	shm.long_settlement_correction_value_quotation_currency,
	shm.next_dividend_quotation_currency,
	shm.next_coupon_quotation_currency,
	shm.balance_nominal_number_unsettled,
		-- New issuer_country_code field
	case 
	    when shm.abor_security_type_id in ('FUT_EQT','FUT_BOND','FUT_IR', 'FUT_COMDTY') then es.esm_country_code
	    when shm.abor_security_type_id = 'CDS' then null
	    else ss.abor_country_id 
	end as issuer_country_code
from holdings.scd_holdings_main shm
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by abor_security_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.enterprise_security
) es
	on shm.abor_security_id = es.abor_security_id
	and es.rn = 1
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by cppib_sec_id order by business_date desc) as rn
	from asset.asset_security_identifiers
) asi
	on shm.cppib_sec_id = cast(asi.cppib_sec_id as varchar(50))
	and asi.rn = 1
left join reference.scd_model_portfolio smp
	on smp.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.scd_model_portfolio)
	and shm.model_portfolio_id = smp.model_portfolio_id
left join reference.scd_securities ss
	on ss.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.scd_securities)
	and shm.abor_security_number = ss.abor_security_number
left join (
	select *, 
	row_number() over(partition by portfolio_id order by business_date desc) latest
	from reference.scd_portfolio
) sp
	on sp.latest = 1
	and shm.portfolio_id = sp.portfolio_id
left join performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten spif
	on spif.business_date = (select max(business_date) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten)
	and shm.model_portfolio_id = spif.model_portfolio
	and spif.investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc
	on rcc.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
	and asi.incorp_country_code = rcc.country_code
left join reference.scd_securities ss_ul
	on cast(ss_ul.scd_security_key_id as varchar) = es.esm_underlying_instrument_id 
	and cast(ss_ul.business_date as date) = es.business_date
	and es.enterprise_security_source = 'SCD'
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_esm
	on rcc_esm.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
	and es.esm_country_code = rcc_esm.country_code
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_incorp_country
	on rcc_incorp_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
	and es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code
left join reference.reference_exchange_codes rec
	on es.esm_exchange_name = rec.exchange_name
	and coalesce(es.mic, 'null') = coalesce(rec.mic, 'null')
	and es.esm_exchange_name != 'UNKNOWN'
	and rec.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_exchange_codes)
left join reference.reference_country_codes rcc_trade_country
	on rec.country_ref_code = rcc_trade_country.country_code
	and rcc_trade_country.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_country_codes)
left join (

left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by abor_security_id order by business_date desc) as rn

	and es.rn = 1
left join (
	select *,
	row_number() over (partition by cppib_sec_id order by business_date desc) as rn

	and shm.portfolio_id = sp.portfolio_id

	and es.esm_incorp_country_code = rcc_incorp_country.country_code

	and es.esm_exchange_name != 'UNKNOWN'
	and rec.business_date = (select max(business_date) from reference.reference_exchange_codes)

	select

		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name,
		sum( lt.total_market_value_pc ) as total_market_value_pc
	from (
		select *
		from 
			holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough
		where
			id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion until fix is implemented in LT product; reference Teams chat with Doug
			and id_model_portfolio not in ( -- Doug says these are test MPs that should be excluded
				  'MIN1000042'
				, 'NPTESTA'
				, 'NPTESTB'
				, 'PMIEMELTCS'
				, 'PMIEMFLTCL'
				, 'PMIEMFLTPA'
				, 'PMIEMFLTVA'
			) 
			and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough ) -- filter only for the data as of the latest business date
	) lt
	left join asset.enterprise_security /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_security_composite*/ secc
	on
		lt.enterprise_security_id = secc.enterprise_security_id
		and lt.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join party.enterprise_party /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite*/ pcc
	on
		secc.enterprise_party_id = pcc.enterprise_party_id
		and pcc.business_date = secc.business_date
	left join party.enterprise_party /*cppib_enterprise_data.enterprise_party_composite*/ uppcc
	on
		pcc.ultimate_parent_enterprise_party_id = uppcc.enterprise_party_id
		and uppcc.business_date = pcc.business_date
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
	on
		lt.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	group by
		lt.business_date,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel1,
		spif.investmentstructurelevel2,
		uppcc.epm_party_name,
		pcc.epm_party_name,
		lt.parent_security_type_name,
		lt.security_type_name,
		lt.security_name
), lt_final as (
	select
		  *
		, coalesce( ultimate_parent_party_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( issuer_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( security_name, '' ) as combined_entity_name_original
		, coalesce( ultimate_parent_party_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( issuer_name, '' ) || ' | ' || coalesce( security_name_clean, '' ) as combined_entity_name_clean
		, case
			when investment_structure_level_01 in ( 'Cash for benefits', 'Accounts' ) then '7. Cash for Benefits and Residual Cash'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Total Fund Management' then '1. Total Fund Management'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' then '2. Capital Markets & Factor Investing'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Active Equities' then '3. Active Equities'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Credit Investments' then '4. Credit Investments'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Private Equity' then '5. Private Equity'
			when investment_structure_level_02 = 'Real Assets' then '6. Real Assets'
	  	  end department_sorted
	from (
		select
			  *
			, case
				when regexp_like( lower( security_type_name ), '.*\b(leg|swap|swaptions|option|future|contract|deposit|paper|collateralized|bond|repo|revrepo|buyselback|selbuyback)\b.*' ) then regexp_replace( security_name, '[0-9]', '' )
				else security_name
			  end security_name_clean
		from 
			lt_base
	)
)
select * from lt_final) AS "holdings_search_holdings_lookthrough"

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:

			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd

			select

				, pnl_4yp_rc

			/* perf_top_down_monthly:

				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc

		from

	cross join unnest (

			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select

		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'

		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'

		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'

			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd

			select

				, node_name 
				, "level"

				(

				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */

					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly

				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on

			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where

				or (

					and scd.split_level = 1

				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'

		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )

	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y

			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:

			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y

			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:

			 */
			select

				, pnl_4yp_rc

			from

				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )

				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365

			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all

		from

			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )

	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' then 'Total Fund Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' then 'Base CPP Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD' then 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
			else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'

		, value

			, pnl_qtd_lc as pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency

			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency

			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'

			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )

	select * from scd_perf

	select * from perf

	select

		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case
			when period = '1D' then '1. 1-Day'
			when period = 'MTD' then '2. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '3. QTD'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '5. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '6. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from

)

),
OMITTED_POSITIONS AS
(
	SELECT pos.pos_id AS pos_id
	FROM CHRONS chron
	JOIN risk_prod.fact_pos_calc_sd sd ON sd.chron_id = chron.chron_id
	JOIN risk_prod.dim_pos_inst pos ON sd.pos_id = pos.pos_id AND sd.chron_id = pos.chron_id
	JOIN risk_prod.dim_pos_lookthrough_pos lt_b ON pos.pos_id = lt_b.parent_pos_id AND pos.chron_id = lt_b.chron_id
	JOIN risk_prod.dim_inst base_inst ON sd.inst_id = base_inst.inst_id AND sd.chron_id = base_inst.chron_id
	JOIN risk_prod.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_account rh ON rh.dim_hierarchy_node_id = sd.dim_hierarchy_node_id AND rh.chron_id = sd.chron_id
	LEFT JOIN risk_prod.dim_inst inst1 ON pos.inst1_id = inst1.inst_id AND pos.chron_id = inst1.chron_id
	LEFT JOIN risk_prod.dim_inst inst2 ON pos.inst2_id = inst2.inst_id AND pos.chron_id = inst2.chron_id
	JOIN risk_prod.dim_pos_inst lt_pos ON lt_b.lookthrough_pos_id = lt_pos.pos_id and lt_pos.qty is not null	
	WHERE pos.portfolio_type = 'TOTAL_FUND_BY_ACCOUNT'
            AND lt_b.lookthrough_ptfl_type = 'INDEX_LOOKTHROUGH'

-- 		AND (SELECT qty FROM risk_prod.dim_pos_inst lt_pos WHERE lt_b.lookthrough_pos_id = lt_pos.pos_id limit 1) IS NOT NULL
		AND
		(
		   1=1
		)
),
TOP_LEVEL_POSITIONS AS
(

	FROM CHRONS chron
	JOIN risk_prod.fact_pos_calc_sd sd ON sd.chron_id = chron.chron_id
      JOIN risk_prod.dim_pos_inst pos ON sd.chron_id = pos.chron_id AND sd.pos_id = pos.pos_id
      JOIN risk_prod.dim_inst base_inst ON sd.chron_id = base_inst.chron_id AND sd.inst_id = base_inst.inst_id
	JOIN risk_prod.dim_hierarchy_node rh ON rh.chron_id = sd.chron_id AND rh.dim_hierarchy_node_id = sd.dim_hierarchy_node_id
	JOIN risk_prod.mv_dim_hierarchy_node_account rhd ON rhd.chron_id = sd.chron_id AND rhd.dim_hierarchy_node_id = sd.dim_hierarchy_node_id

	LEFT JOIN wf_vw_ref_legal_entity cp_le ON pos.chron_id = cp_le.chron_id AND pos.pos_counter_party_id = cp_le.legal_entity_id
	LEFT JOIN wf_vw_ref_legal_entity fundmgr_le ON pos.chron_id = fundmgr_le.chron_id AND pos.fund_manager_id = fundmgr_le.legal_entity_id

	LEFT JOIN risk_prod.dim_instrument_rating inst_rating on base_inst.chron_id = inst_rating.chron_id AND base_inst.inst_id = inst_rating.dim_inst_id
      WHERE pos.portfolio_type = 'TOTAL_FUND_BY_ACCOUNT'

	   AND ( rh.node_path LIKE '%CPPIB-ALL%' )

		AND
		(

		)

/* cppi::9949ca7fc74c1e54869aa44788ffaec68b84a76d52cd65062d242c6b5b291211 */
/* QuickSight 975d5818-5215-44e1-a1a2-60912a8f9f50 */
SELECT "id_model_portfolio", "InvestmentStructureLevel1", "InvestmentStructureLevel2", "from_date", "to_date", "from_date_total_market_value_pc", "to_date_total_market_value_pc"
FROM (/*
 * IDENTIFY UNMAPPED MPs IN HOLDINGS LOOKTHROUGH
 */	
select
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date
	, sum( from_date_total_market_value_pc ) as from_date_total_market_value_pc
	, sum( to_date_total_market_value_pc ) as to_date_total_market_value_pc
from (
	select distinct
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
		, min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as from_date
		, max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) as to_date
		, case 
			when mhl.business_date = min( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc
		  end from_date_total_market_value_pc
		, case
			when mhl.business_date = max( mhl.business_date ) over ( partition by mhl.id_model_portfolio ) then mhl.total_market_value_pc 
		  end to_date_total_market_value_pc
	from 
		holdings.ma_holding_lookthrough mhl
	/* MAP TO INVESTMENT STRUCTURE */
	left join
		( 	select *
			from 	performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten
			where 	investmentstructure = 'CPPIB_F24'
					and business_date = ( select max( business_date ) from performance.scd_performance_invstr_flatten )
		) spif
			on mhl.id_model_portfolio = spif.model_portfolio
	where
		mhl.id_model_portfolio != 'PMIEMFLTCC' -- temporary exclusion
		and mhl.pool_name not in ( 'ACPP', 'BCPP' )
		and spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1 is null
	order by 
		  mhl.id_model_portfolio 
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel1
		, spif.InvestmentStructureLevel2
)
group by 
	  id_model_portfolio 
	, InvestmentStructureLevel1
	, InvestmentStructureLevel2
	, from_date
	, to_date) AS "finsights_control_holdings_unmapped_mp"

/* cppi::0235f2ed81bc51fa10bcb3f937e791c65baafb7ab71c277b3593aa2ddec7d266 */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.waf_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 25
		AND hour between 20 and 21
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-25 20:38:00'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

/* cppi::1c4ec0a32b974491afd33bd72318c1819fe0be0896ae3dfd8329fa48d9dd8d43 */
Select
CASH_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier,
    CASH_COUPON.quantity_net,
    CASH_COUPON.loan_contract_fx_rate,
    
    Null                                as InstrumentDetails,
    SEC.scd_id                          as ClientInstrumentID,
    SEC.origination_date                as InformationDate,
    Case
        When CASH_COUPON.colc_include_spread_adjustment = 'True' Then 'Yes'
        When PIK_COUPON.colc_include_spread_adjustment  = 'True' Then 'Yes'
        Else 'No'
    End                                 as CreditSpreadAdjustmentIsApplicable,
    Case
        When CASH_COUPON.colc_include_spread_adjustment = 'True' Then CASH_COUPON.colc_spread_adjustment
        When PIK_COUPON.colc_include_spread_adjustment = 'True'  Then PIK_COUPON.colc_spread_adjustment
        Else Null
    End                                 as CreditSpreadAdjustment,
--////////////// START OF THE CASH SECTION //////////////////////////
    Case WHEN CASH_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is null then 'No' Else 'Yes' End as PaysCashInterest,
    Null                                as CashStartDate,
    Null                                as CashEndDate,
    Null                                as CashAccruedAmount,
    Case WHEN CASH_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is null then Null Else
    Case
        When CASH_COUPON.colc_fixed_floating = 'Floating' Then 'Yes'
        Else 'No'
    End End                                 as CashInterestIsFloating,
    Case
        When CASH_COUPON.colc_fixed_floating = 'Floating' Then CASH_COUPON.colc_index_name
        Else Null
    End                                 as CashBaseRateIndex,   -- Needs translation table
    Case When CASH_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is NULL Then 'No' Else
    Case When sched.value_decimal is not null Then 'Yes' 
         Else 'No'
    End End                                 as CashBaseRateIndexIsCappedFloored,
    Case When CASH_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is NULL Then Null Else
    Case When sched.schedule_name = 'CreditFacility_IndexCap'   Then sched.value_decimal
         Else Null
    End End                                 as CashBaseRateIndexCap,
    Case When CASH_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is NULL Then Null Else
    Case When sched.schedule_name = 'CreditFacility_IndexFloor' Then sched.value_decimal
         Else Null
    End End                                 as CashBaseRateIndexFloor,
    Case When CASH_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is NULL Then Null Else 'Fixed' End as CashMarginType,
    Case
        When CASH_COUPON.colc_fixed_floating = 'Floating' Then CASH_COUPON.colc_spread
        Else CASH_COUPON.colc_fixed_rate
    End                                 as CashFixedSpreadAmount,
    Null                                as CashMetric,
    Null                                as CashMetricValueMarginGrid,
    --For Loans default the CashTotalInterestRateIsCappedFloored to No, Null,NUll
    Case When CASH_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is NULL Then Null Else 'No'  End  as CashTotalInterestRateIsCappedFloored,
    Null                                  as CashTotalInterestRateCap,
    Null                                  as CashTotalInterestRateFloor,
    CASH_COUPON.colc_day_count_name       as CashDayCountConvention, 
--////////////// END OF THE CASH SECTION //////////////////////////    
--*************************************PIK SECTION **************************************************************************
--NEED TO TEST IF A PIK CONTRACT EXISTS AND NULL THIS ENTIRE SECTION IF IT DOES NOT.
    Case WHEN PIK_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is null then 'No' Else 'Yes' End as PaysPIKInterest,
    Null                                as PIKStartDate,
    Null                                as PIKEndDate,
    Null                                as PIKAccruedAmount,
    Case WHEN PIK_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is Null Then Null Else
    Case
        When PIK_COUPON.colc_fixed_floating = 'Floating' Then 'Yes'
        Else 'No'
    End End                                 as PIKInterestIsFloating,
    Case WHEN PIK_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is Null Then Null Else
    Case
        When PIK_COUPON.colc_fixed_floating = 'Floating' Then PIK_COUPON.colc_index_name
        Else Null
    End End                                 as PIKBaseRateIndex,   --NEEDS TRANSLATION TABLE
    Case WHEN PIK_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is Null Then Null Else 
			Case When sched.value_decimal is not null Then 'Yes' 
	         	 Else 'No'
    End	End    		                         as PIKBaseRateIndexIsCappedFloored,
    Case WHEN PIK_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is Null Then Null Else
    		Case When sched.schedule_name = 'CreditFacility_IndexCap'   Then sched.value_decimal
	         Else Null
    End End                                  as PIKBaseRateIndexCap,
    Case WHEN PIK_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is Null Then Null Else
    		Case When sched.schedule_name = 'CreditFacility_IndexFloor' Then sched.value_decimal
         	Else Null
    End End                                  as PIKBaseRateIndexFloor,
	Case WHEN PIK_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is Null Then Null Else 'Fixed' End as PIKMarginType,
    Case WHEN PIK_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is Null Then Null Else
    Case
        When PIK_COUPON.colc_fixed_floating = 'Floating' Then PIK_COUPON.colc_spread
        Else PIK_COUPON.colc_fixed_rate
    End End                                 as PIKFixedSpreadAmount,
    Null                                    as PIKMetric,
    Null                                    as PIKMetricValueMarginGrid,
    Case WHEN PIK_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is Null Then Null Else
    Case
        When PIK_COUPON.colc_has_cap_rate   = 'True' or  PIK_COUPON.colc_has_floor_rate = 'True' Then 'Yes'
        Else 'No'
    End End                                 as PIKTotalInterestRateIsCappedFloored,
    Case WHEN PIK_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is Null Then Null Else
    Case
        When PIK_COUPON.colc_has_cap_rate   = 'True' Then PIK_COUPON.colc_cap_rate
        Else Null
    End End                                 as PIKTotalInterestRateCap,
    Case WHEN PIK_COUPON.loan_contract_identifier is Null Then Null Else
    Case
        When PIK_COUPON.colc_has_floor_rate = 'True' Then PIK_COUPON.colc_floor_rate
        Else Null
    End End                                 as PIKTotalInterestRateFloor,
    PIK_COUPON.colc_day_count_name          as PIKDayCountConvention     --NEEDS TRANSLATION TABLE
FROM
    reference.ci_sentry_security SEC
    left join (	Select * from (
				Select
					COUP.business_date, COUP.security_identifier, COUP.sentry_security_type, COUP.loan_contract_identifier,
					COUP.colc_first_accrual_date, COUP.colc_fixed_rate, COUP.colc_fixed_floating, COUP.colc_spread, COUP.colc_index_name,
					colc_day_count_name, colc_payment_frequency, colc_pay_convention, facility_maturity_date, loan_contract_status,
					COUP.colc_include_spread_adjustment,COUP.colc_spread_adjustment,COUP.colc_has_cap_rate,COUP.colc_has_floor_rate,
					COUP.colc_cap_rate,COUP.colc_floor_rate,TRD.quantity_net,COUP.colc_all_in_rate,COUP.loan_contract_fx_rate,
					ROW_NUMBER()  OVER( Partition by (COUP.business_date, COUP.security_identifier, loan_contract_currency)
					Order By COUP.security_identifier, COUP.loan_contract_status, COUP.loan_contract_type, TRD.quantity_net desc, COUP.loan_contract_identifier desc ) AS Row
                        --Note The loan_contract_status orders - Active, Matured, Not_Traded.
				From
					reference.ci_sentry_security_coupon COUP
					left join (Select security_identifier,sum(cast( quantity_net as decimal(19,5) )) as quantity_net --This security_identifier is a loan_contract_identifier
								From  trades_deals.ci_sentry_cashflows_all_transactions
								Where security_type = 'loanContract' and transaction_code in ('ROLL+','ROLL-')
									and transaction_type = 'transaction' and is_cancelled = 'False' and date(trade_date) <= date('2025-06-24')
								Group by security_identifier) TRD on COUP.loan_contract_identifier = TRD.security_identifier
				Where
					COUP.loan_contract_type <> 'PIK'
					and business_date = '2025-06-24'
				) CASH Where Row = 1 AND CASH.quantity_net <> 0	 and CASH.colc_all_in_rate <> 0 
			)	CASH_COUPON on SEC.security_identifier = CASH_COUPON.security_identifier
    left join ( Select * from (
				Select
					COUP.business_date, COUP.security_identifier, COUP.sentry_security_type, COUP.loan_contract_identifier,
					COUP.colc_first_accrual_date, COUP.colc_fixed_rate, COUP.colc_fixed_floating, COUP.colc_spread, COUP.colc_index_name,
					COUP.colc_day_count_name, COUP.colc_payment_frequency, COUP.colc_pay_convention, COUP.facility_maturity_date, COUP.loan_contract_status,
					COUP.colc_include_spread_adjustment,COUP.colc_spread_adjustment,COUP.colc_has_cap_rate,COUP.colc_has_floor_rate,
					COUP.colc_cap_rate,COUP.colc_floor_rate,TRD.quantity_net, COUP.colc_all_in_rate,COUP.loan_contract_fx_rate,
					ROW_NUMBER()  OVER( Partition by (COUP.business_date, COUP.security_identifier, loan_contract_currency)
					Order By COUP.security_identifier, COUP.loan_contract_status, COUP.loan_contract_type, TRD.quantity_net desc, COUP.loan_contract_identifier desc ) AS Row
                        --Note The loan_contract_status orders - Active, Matured, Not_Traded.
				From
					reference.ci_sentry_security_coupon COUP
					left join (Select security_identifier,sum(cast(quantity_net as decimal(19,5) ))  as quantity_net --This security_identifier is a loan_contract_identifier
								From  trades_deals.ci_sentry_cashflows_all_transactions
								Where security_type = 'loanContract' and transaction_code in ('ROLL+','ROLL-')
									and transaction_type = 'transaction' and is_cancelled = 'False' and date(trade_date) <= date('2025-06-24')
								Group by security_identifier) TRD on COUP.loan_contract_identifier = TRD.security_identifier
				Where
					COUP.loan_contract_type = 'PIK'
					and COUP.business_date = '2025-06-24'
				) PIK Where Row = 1	AND PIK.quantity_net <> 0 AND PIK.colc_all_in_rate <> 0	
			) PIK_COUPON on SEC.security_identifier = PIK_COUPON.security_identifier
	left join (select sched.* from reference.ci_sentry_security_schedules sched
                    where
                    sched.business_date = '2025-06-24' 
                    and sched.end_date <> '' 
                    and date('2025-06-24') between date(sched.start_date) and date(sched.end_date)
                    and sched.schedule_name in ('CreditFacility_IndexFloor', 'CreditFacility_IndexCap'))  sched on SEC.security_identifier = sched.security_identifier
where
    date('2025-06-24') between date(SEC.start_date) and date(SEC.end_date)    
    and SEC.sentry_security_type IN ('termLoanFacility','delayedDrawLoanFacility','revolvingCreditFacility')
    and SEC.scd_id in ('PD1000856', 'PD1000997', 'PD1000994')
Order by
	SEC.scd_id

        Else Null

    reference.ci_sentry_security SEC
    left join (	Select * from (
				Select
					COUP.business_date, COUP.security_identifier, COUP.sentry_security_type, COUP.loan_contract_identifier,

					COUP.colc_cap_rate,COUP.colc_floor_rate,TRD.quantity_net,COUP.colc_all_in_rate,COUP.loan_contract_fx_rate,
					ROW_NUMBER()  OVER( Partition by (COUP.business_date, COUP.security_identifier, loan_contract_currency)

				From
					reference.ci_sentry_security_coupon COUP
					left join (Select security_identifier,sum(cast( quantity_net as decimal(19,5) )) as quantity_net --This security_identifier is a loan_contract_identifier

								Group by security_identifier) TRD on COUP.loan_contract_identifier = TRD.security_identifier
				Where
					COUP.loan_contract_type <> 'PIK'
					and business_date = '2025-06-24'
				) CASH Where Row = 1 AND CASH.quantity_net <> 0	 and CASH.colc_all_in_rate <> 0 
			)	CASH_COUPON on SEC.security_identifier = CASH_COUPON.security_identifier
    left join ( Select * from (
				Select
					COUP.business_date, COUP.security_identifier, COUP.sentry_security_type, COUP.loan_contract_identifier,
					COUP.colc_first_accrual_date, COUP.colc_fixed_rate, COUP.colc_fixed_floating, COUP.colc_spread, COUP.colc_index_name,

					COUP.colc_include_spread_adjustment,COUP.colc_spread_adjustment,COUP.colc_has_cap_rate,COUP.colc_has_floor_rate,
					COUP.colc_cap_rate,COUP.colc_floor_rate,TRD.quantity_net, COUP.colc_all_in_rate,COUP.loan_contract_fx_rate,
					ROW_NUMBER()  OVER( Partition by (COUP.business_date, COUP.security_identifier, loan_contract_currency)
					Order By COUP.security_identifier, COUP.loan_contract_status, COUP.loan_contract_type, TRD.quantity_net desc, COUP.loan_contract_identifier desc ) AS Row

					reference.ci_sentry_security_coupon COUP
					left join (Select security_identifier,sum(cast(quantity_net as decimal(19,5) ))  as quantity_net --This security_identifier is a loan_contract_identifier
								From  trades_deals.ci_sentry_cashflows_all_transactions
								Where security_type = 'loanContract' and transaction_code in ('ROLL+','ROLL-')
									and transaction_type = 'transaction' and is_cancelled = 'False' and date(trade_date) <= date('2025-06-24')
								Group by security_identifier) TRD on COUP.loan_contract_identifier = TRD.security_identifier
				Where
					COUP.loan_contract_type = 'PIK'
					and COUP.business_date = '2025-06-24'
				) PIK Where Row = 1	AND PIK.quantity_net <> 0 AND PIK.colc_all_in_rate <> 0	
			) PIK_COUPON on SEC.security_identifier = PIK_COUPON.security_identifier
	left join (select sched.* from reference.ci_sentry_security_schedules sched
                    where
                    sched.business_date = '2025-06-24' 
                    and sched.end_date <> '' 
                    and date('2025-06-24') between date(sched.start_date) and date(sched.end_date)
                    and sched.schedule_name in ('CreditFacility_IndexFloor', 'CreditFacility_IndexCap'))  sched on SEC.security_identifier = sched.security_identifier

    date('2025-06-24') between date(SEC.start_date) and date(SEC.end_date)

    and SEC.scd_id in ('PD1000856', 'PD1000997', 'PD1000994')
Order by

SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			wafprodcloudformationstac_ispj5m.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 25
		AND hour between 03 and 04
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-25 03:15:24'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

WITH 
	cred_exp_by_country AS
	  (
		SELECT
		  COALESCE(ref_country.name, parent.domicile_country_code) AS country,
		  parent.sovr_country_rating AS rating,
		  parent.sovr_country_outlook AS outlook,
		  GREATEST(0, SUM( CASE WHEN pos.is_pos_fi = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(fact.credit_exposure, 0) ELSE 0 END )) AS tot_exposure,
		  parent.sovr_fi_limit AS tot_limit,
		  MAX( parent.region_fi_limit ) AS region_fi_limit
		FROM radar_reporting_uat.fact_cr_exposure fact

WITH boundary_dates AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN business_date <= DATE '2021-11-01' THEN business_date END) AS lower_bound,
        MAX(CASE WHEN business_date <= DATE '2025-06-24' THEN business_date END) AS upper_bound
    FROM market.refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr
    WHERE source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
),
cad_fx AS (
    SELECT 
        from_currency,
        ROUND(CASE 
            WHEN UPPER(inverse_quoted) = 'Y' THEN 1 / mid_price 
            ELSE mid_price 
        END, 8) AS mid_price,
        business_date
    FROM market.refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr r
    JOIN boundary_dates b ON r.business_date BETWEEN b.lower_bound AND b.upper_bound
    WHERE r.from_currency = 'USD'
      AND r.to_currency = 'CAD'
      AND r.source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
),
cross_fx AS (
    SELECT 
        MainTable.to_currency AS from_currency,
        ROUND(
            CASE 
                WHEN UPPER(MainTable.inverse_quoted) = 'Y' THEN MainTable.mid_price * cad.mid_price
                ELSE (1 / MainTable.mid_price) * cad.mid_price
            END, 8
        ) AS calc_mid_price,
        MainTable.business_date
    FROM market.refinitiv_exchange_rates_wmr MainTable
    JOIN boundary_dates b ON MainTable.business_date BETWEEN b.lower_bound AND b.upper_bound
    LEFT JOIN cad_fx cad ON MainTable.business_date = cad.business_date
    WHERE MainTable.from_currency = 'USD'
      AND MainTable.mid_price != 0
      AND MainTable.source = 'WM Refinitiv Spot'
)

               model_portfolio,
               model_portfolio_name

CAST(f.pv AS decimal(22,6)) as pv
from (
select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "var95", run_id from

where business_date = '2025-06-24'

(select benchmark_name, hierarchy_type, hierarchy_node, analytic_value as "mean", run_id from

 FROM (

SELECT "business_date", "vendor", "base_currency", "to_currency", "is_exchange_holiday_flag", "exchange_rate"
FROM (with original_data as (
	select
		  data_date as business_date
		, vendor
		, 'CAD' as base_currency
		, currency as to_currency
		, is_exchange_holiday_flag
		, exchange_rate
	from
		market.cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad
	where
		currency != 'CAD'
), inverse_data as (
	select
		  data_date as business_date
		, vendor
		, currency as base_currency
		, 'CAD' as to_currency
		, is_exchange_holiday_flag
		, 1 / exchange_rate as exchange_rate
	from
		market.cppib_market_exchange_rate_cad
	where
		currency != 'CAD'
), combined_data_clean as (
	select *
	from (
		select * from original_data
		union all
		select * from inverse_data
	)
	where exchange_rate is not null 
)
select * from combined_data_clean) AS "finsights_markets_fx_cad"

/* cppi::04baaeeb1346a37d39537aed78f328bc80ba990205b8bef803f5fbc767c7b9fa */
SELECT
	client_ip,
	MAX_BY(counter, counter) as max_counter_per_min
 FROM (
	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			client_ip,
			target_status_code AS status,
			parse_datetime(time, 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS''Z') AS datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafprod_yn4b94.app_access_logs
		WHERE year = 2025
		AND month = 06
		AND day = 25
		AND hour between 07 and 08
	)
	SELECT
		client_ip,
		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-25 07:13:37'
		AND status = ANY (VALUES '400', '401', '403', '404', '405')
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 500
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

	WITH logs_with_concat_data AS (
		SELECT
			httprequest.clientip as client_ip,
			from_unixtime(timestamp/1000) as datetime
		FROM
			publicinboundwafnonprod_azf8db.waf_access_logs

		AND month = 06
		AND day = 25
		AND hour between 06 and 07

		COUNT(*) as counter
	FROM
		logs_with_concat_data
	WHERE
		datetime > TIMESTAMP '2025-06-25 06:11:58'
	GROUP BY
		client_ip,
		date_trunc('minute', datetime)
	HAVING
		COUNT(*) >= 10000.0
) GROUP BY
	client_ip
ORDER BY
	max_counter_per_min DESC
LIMIT 10000

FROM (with asset_class_base as (
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, node_name as pbor_node_name
		, "level" as split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_rc' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_lc' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%_qtd_%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%_3m_%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%_fytd_%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%_1y_roll_%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%_4yp_%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%_5y_roll_%' then '5Y'
			else 'MTD'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id 
			, business_date 
			, node_name 
			, "level"
			, time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
			, last_update 
		from 
			performance_dev.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where
			dataset_id = 'ASSETCL_CMB'
			and periods_per_year = 12
			and "level" = 1
			and node_name != 'Excluded' -- Per Michael Brown from Performance team, the Excluded node should be excluded from reporting
	) pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fytd_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4yp_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_3m_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_1y_roll_lc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc
		  ]

	select
		  asset_class_base.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, cast( format( '%1$tY%1$tm%1$td', business_date ) as int ) as business_date_int
		, date_format( business_date, '%Y-%m' ) as year_month
		--, format( '%1$tY-%1$tm', calendar_date ) as year_month
		, case
			when period = 'MTD' then '1. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '2. QTD'
			when period = '3M' then '3. 3M'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '1Y' then '5. 1Y'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '6. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '7. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		asset_class_base
	where
		business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		/*and not ( period in ( 'MTD', 'QTD', '3M', 'FYTD', '1Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2015-06-30' as date ) )
		and not ( period in ( '4Y+FYTD', '5Y' ) and business_date < cast( '2020-03-31' as date ) )*/
)
select * from asset_class_clean) AS "finsights_perf_returns_asset_class_DEV"

			when metric like '%_qtd_%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%_3m_%' then '3M'
			when metric like '%_fytd_%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%_1y_roll_%' then '1Y'
			when metric like '%_4yp_%' then '4Y+FYTD'

		, value
	from (

			, time_weighted_return_rc
			, time_weighted_return_lc

			, 'time_weighted_return_lc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_rc'
			, 'time_weighted_return_qtd_lc'

SELECT "dataset_id", "business_date", "pbor_node_name", "split_level", "metric_type", "currency", "period", "value", "business_date_string", "period_sorted"
FROM (with scd_perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, cast( business_date as date ) as business_date
		, case 
			when dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' ) and split_level = 0 then 'Total Fund'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Base CPP'
			when dataset_id = 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' and split_level = 0 then 'Additional CPP'
			when dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF', 'ATP_TF_D' ) and split_level = 1 then 'Total Fund Benchmark Portfolio'
		  	else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  scd.dataset_id 
			, scd.business_date 
			, scd.pbor_node_name 
			, scd.split_level 
			-- for below, TOTALFUND local values should be not used; CMBP_NET CAD values should not be used
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_local_currency end time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency end time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_reporting_currency end pnl_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_local_currency end pnl_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_month_to_date_local_currency end pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency end pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, perf.pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency end pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.pnl_5year_roll_local_currency end pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
			, scd.last_update
		from 
			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:
			 * - Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 * - Department: 1D, MTD, QTD, FYTD, 5Y
			 */
			performance.scd_performance_bottom_up scd
		left join (
			/* perf_bottom_up_monthly:
			 * - Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 * - Total Fund bCPP/aCPP: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else time_weighted_return_4yp_lc end time_weighted_return_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, case when dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND_D' then null else pnl_4yp_lc end pnl_4yp_lc /* TOTALFUND local should not be used */
			from
				performance.perf_bottom_up_monthly 
			where 
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND_D' )
					and "level" = 0
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP_D', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP_D' )
					and "level" = 0 
					and periods_per_year = 365
				)
			/* perf_top_down_monthly:
			 * - Benchmark Portfolio Total Fund: 4Y+FYTD
			 */
			union all
			select
				  replace( dataset_id, '_D', '' ) as dataset_id 
				, business_date 
				, node_name 
				, "level" 
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc
				, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc
				, pnl_4yp_rc
				, pnl_4yp_lc
			from
				performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
			where 
				periods_per_year = 365
				and dataset_id = 'ATP_TF_D'
		) perf
		on
			scd.business_date = cast( perf.business_date as varchar )
			and scd.dataset_id = perf.dataset_id
			and scd.pbor_node_name = perf.node_name
			and scd.split_level = perf."level"
		where 
			scd.periods_per_year = '365'
			and (
				/* TOTAL FUND */
				(
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'TOTALFUND', 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 0
				)
				/* TOTAL FUND ACCOUNTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ACCOUNTS_BCPP', 'ACCOUNTS_ACPP' )
					and scd.split_level = 0 
				)
				/* BENCHMARK PORTFOLIO */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'ATP_TF' )
					and scd.split_level = 1
				)
				/* DEPARTMENTS */
				or (
					scd.dataset_id in ( 'CMBP_NET' )
					and scd.split_level = 2
					and scd.pbor_parent_node_id = 2
				)
			)
	) scd_perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_month_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_month_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) scd_perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), perf as (
	/* DATA PULLED:
	 * - Benchmark Portfolio bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) Total Fund: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 * - Value-Added (IP-BP) bCPP/aCPP: 1D, QTD, FYTD, 4Y+FYTD, 5Y
	 */
	select
		  dataset_id
		, business_date
		, case
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_BCPP_D' then 'Base CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'ATP_ACPP_D' then 'Additional CPP Benchmark Portfolio'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_TF_D' then 'Total Fund Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' then 'Base CPP Value-Added'
			when dataset_id = 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD' then 'Additional CPP Value-Added'
			else pbor_node_name
		  end pbor_node_name
		, split_level
		, case
			when metric like 'time_weighted_return_%' then 'Return'
			when metric like 'pnl_%' then 'Income'
		  end metric_type
		, case
			when metric like '%_reporting_currency' then 'CAD'
			when metric like '%_local_currency' then 'Local'
		  end currency
		, case
			when metric like '%month_to_date%' then 'MTD'
			when metric like '%quarter_to_date%' then 'QTD'
			when metric like '%fiscal_year_to_date%' then 'FYTD'
			when metric like '%4year_plus%' then '4Y+FYTD'
			when metric like '%5year_roll%' then '5Y'
			else '1D'
		  end period
		, value
	from (
		select
			  dataset_id
			, business_date
			, node_name as pbor_node_name
			, "level" as split_level
			, time_weighted_return_rc as time_weighted_return_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_lc as time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_rc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_qtd_lc as time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_rc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fytd_lc as time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_rc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4yp_lc as time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_rc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5y_roll_lc as time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_rc as pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_lc as pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_qtd_rc as pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_qtd_lc as pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fytd_rc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fytd_lc as pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4yp_rc as pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4yp_lc as pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_rc as pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5y_roll_lc as pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		from
			performance.perf_top_down_monthly 
		where 
			dataset_id in ( 'ATP_BCPP_D', 'ATP_ACPP_D', 'INV_SELECT_TF_D', 'INV_SELECT_ACPPD', 'INV_SELECT_BCPPD' )
			and "level" = 1
	) perf_pivot
	cross join unnest (
		/* METRIC */
		array[
		  	  'time_weighted_return_reporting_currency' 
			, 'time_weighted_return_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_4year_plus_local_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency'
			, 'pnl_5year_roll_local_currency'
		  ]
		/* VALUE */
		, array[
			  time_weighted_return_reporting_currency 
			, time_weighted_return_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_4year_plus_local_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, time_weighted_return_5year_roll_local_currency
			, pnl_reporting_currency
			, pnl_local_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_quarter_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, pnl_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_reporting_currency
			, pnl_4year_plus_local_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_reporting_currency
			, pnl_5year_roll_local_currency
		  ]
	) perf_unpivot ( metric, value )
), cmb as (
	select * from scd_perf
	union all
	select * from perf
), cmb_clean as (
	select
		cmb.*
		, cast( business_date as varchar ) as business_date_string
		, case
			when period = '1D' then '1. 1-Day'
			when period = 'MTD' then '2. MTD'
			when period = 'QTD' then '3. QTD'
			when period = 'FYTD' then '4. FYTD'
			when period = '4Y+FYTD' then '5. 4Y+FYTD'
			when period = '5Y' then '6. 5Y'
		  end period_sorted
	from
		cmb
	where
		value is not null
		and business_date >= cast( '2019-04-01' as date )
		and not ( pbor_node_name in ( 'Active Equities', 'Capital Markets & Factor Investing' ) and metric_type = 'Return' )
)
select * from cmb_clean) AS "finsights_perf_returns_income_daily"
WHERE "business_date" > from_unixtime(cast(substr(cast(1750250735772 as varchar), 1, 10) AS bigint))

			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'CMBP_NET' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_reporting_currency
			, case when scd.dataset_id = 'TOTALFUND' and scd.split_level = 0 then null else scd.time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency end time_weighted_return_fiscal_year_to_date_local_currency

			/* scd_performance_bottom_up:

			, time_weighted_return_month_to_date_local_currency
